brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：把每组等式解到底；对不上或者没有解的，说「失败」。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that solves each set of equations to the end, or says “failed” when they do not fit or have no solution.

hint.zh: ?P 后面跟着几个变量，解出的函数就有几个参数，次序同 ?P 后面的次序。
hint.en: However many variables follow ?P, the function found has that many parameters, in the order they follow ?P.

t.zh: ?P(x, y) 是一句关于 x 和 y 的话。两个「对所有」逐层拆开，等式前记上 ⋀x y；?P 后面跟着两个不同的约束变量，仍是模式。
t.en: ?P(x, y) is a sentence about x and y. Two “for all” split one after the other mark the equation ⋀x y; ?P followed by two distinct bound variables is still a pattern.
